rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for throwing something away or getting rid of it.

example.english: We can discard these old newspapers now.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2 ho2 ji5 deu6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when discarding means deciding not to want, keep, or accept something rather than physically throwing it away.

example.english: The terms of this contract are too harsh, so we’ll discard it.
example.traditional: 呢份合約條款太苛刻，我哋唔要喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2 taai3 ho1 hak1 ngo5 dei6 m4 jiu3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the abstract sense of discarding or giving up an idea, plan, or belief.

example.english: We decided to discard that plan in the end.
example.traditional: 我哋最後決定放棄嗰個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 fong3 hei3 go2 go3 gai3 waak6
